00085 XFadeLoopPlayBufUGenInternal::XFadeLoopPlayBufUGenInternal(XFadeLoopSpec const& spec, UGen const& rate)
00086 :   ProxyOwnerUGenInternal(NumInputs, spec.getNumChannels() - 1),
00087     fadeTime(spec.getFadeTime()),
00088     startLoop(spec.getStartLoop()),
00089     endLoop(spec.getEndLoop()),
00090     soundOnset(spec.getSoundOnset()),
00091     soundLoop(spec.getSoundLoop()),
00092     bufferData(new float*[spec.getNumChannels()])
00093 {
00094     inputs[Rate] = rate;
00095     
00096     float startLoopRate = UGen::getSampleRate() / startLoop;
00097     UGen trig = Impulse::AR(startLoopRate * rate);
00098     
00099     const int maxRepeats = 2;
00100     graph = TrigXFade<OnsetLoopXFade, XFadeLoopPlayBufUGenInternal>::AR(spec.getNumChannels(), 
00101                                                                         trig, 
00102                                                                         ugen::max(fadeTime, 0.05f), 
00103                                                                         maxRepeats,
00104                                                                         this);
00105 }

00112 void XFadeLoopPlayBufUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00113 {   
00114     const int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();  
00115     const int numChannels = getNumChannels();
00116     for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00117     {
00118         bufferData[channel] = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00119     }
00120     
00121     graph.prepareForBlock(numSamplesToProcess, blockID);
00122     graph.setOutputs(bufferData, numSamplesToProcess, numChannels);
00123     graph.processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, -1);
00124 }
